snippet.title: Away From Home Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: May 2025
snippet.description:
A Rhythm based RPG experience. Providing detailed pixel art and expressive animation. Experience a fun world with lots of colorful characters. Come and disrupt their peace!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631980/Away_From_Home/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.
